slice: PAR-134 SH-history CMC metadata retention and typed-DXF no-loss guard
source_reference: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §2.11 CmColor

scope.dxf_scope: typed ACSH BOX history-node color projection to group 62

implementation.model: Append CMC provenance fields to DRW_AcShHistoryObject::HistoryNodePrefix; existing name/book callback accounting already includes sizeof(DRW_AcShHistoryObject) and retained string bytes.
implementation.parser: readShHistoryNodePrefix captures method/flags/index through readCmColorWithinBounds and marks the BS as reserved for AC1018+.
implementation.dxf_writer: Allow only scalar-faithful C0 ByLayer, C1 ByBlock, and C3 ACI when DWG CMC provenance exists. Refuse C2, optional names/books, unknown methods, any flags, inconsistent method/scalar pairs, and nonzero R2004+ reserved index before publishing typed ACSH output.
implementation.compatibility: Caller-created values without parsed CMC provenance retain prior behavior. HistoryNodePrefix public layout changes; downstream consumers must rebuild.

generated_controls.parser_positive: C0, C1, C3, named black C2, and C5 Foreground generated AC1024 frames verify normalized color projection, method/flags/index retention, copy/assignment/reset, following BOX dimensions, and material-handle alignment.
generated_controls.parser_raw_metadata: Unknown 0x80 flags and nonzero reserved BS are retained without disrupting the subsequent shape fields.
generated_controls.dxf_atomic_refusal: Generated ASCII C5 method and nonzero reserved-index cases plus Binary unknown-flags case refuse export while preserving the existing sentinel destination.
